payload.description_html:
The larger tracks represent Caririchnium leonardii, which were made by iguanodontid (ornithopod) dinosaurs.  The slender track represents Magnoavipes, which was made by a theropod or ornithopod dinosaur.
Locality: eastern side of Dinosaur Ridge, between Interstate 70 and the town of Morrison, west of Denver, north-central Colorado, USA
